# Proposed architecture decision

**Status: Proposed — project acceptance required.**

Engine 0.8.0; catalog 0.4.0; services 0.8.0; analysis 0.2.0.
Input SHA-256: e59b99293f954ec6519e26d493899ec3da1d113b94de259cd8b64ac6c3c9dbba.

## Original result

static recommendation selected from 10 complete compatible plans; month\-12 infrastructure planning band USD 0–0/month\.
Result: ok.

- frontend: Astro — Covers requested targets web with static rendering\. Team languages: css, html, javascript\. Markdown content authoring was explicitly considered\. Selected after supporting\-service compatibility and whole\-plan infrastructure cost scoring\. Explicit critical warnings identify provisional data\-flow/control exceptions\.
- backend: None — Static content has no inferred dynamic server requirement; omitting the backend avoids an unnecessary operated application\. Selected after supporting\-service compatibility and whole\-plan infrastructure cost scoring\. Explicit critical warnings identify provisional data\-flow/control exceptions\.
- database: None — No server persistence need was inferred; a database is omitted from this core plan\. Selected after supporting\-service compatibility and whole\-plan infrastructure cost scoring\. Explicit critical warnings identify provisional data\-flow/control exceptions\.
- hosting: Cloudflare Pages — Matches managed\_cloud with provider cloudflare; no country/region assurance was requested or inferred\. Required runtimes and separate database deployment were checked\. Selected after supporting\-service compatibility and whole\-plan infrastructure cost scoring\. Explicit critical warnings identify provisional data\-flow/control exceptions\.

Monthly infrastructure/operations band (activity fees additional): USD 0–0.

## Complete alternatives

- static\|astro\|backend\-none\|database\-none\|pages\|unspecified; score 86; USD 0–0; selected.
- static\|html\|backend\-none\|database\-none\|pages\|unspecified; score 82; USD 0–0; alternative.
- static\|astro\|backend\-none\|database\-none\|cloudrun\|unspecified; score 61; USD 19.13–144.75; alternative.

## Preference stability

Original winner retained in 25/25 tested settings; 1 observed winners. Counts are not confidence probabilities.

## Cost assumptions

- Horizon: expected month\-12 footprint; 730 hours/month\. No tax, development/on\-call labor, domain registration or new on\-prem hardware procurement is included\.
- Peak concurrency supplied: 50; not equated directly with requests/second\.
- RPS absent: assumed 50 requests/user/day averaged across the day \(1\.736 RPS\); peak capacity still uses the concurrency hypothesis\.
- Data volume 1 GB supplied; egress 30 GB/month assumed at 0\.01 GB per year\-12 user, minimum 1 GB; backup retention 1 months assumed\.
- Static hosting/CDN is one bundled resource\. Use local builds within current build/file limits; no Functions, paid CI overages, custom domain or dynamic database is assumed\.
- Headline estimate and budget fit cover infrastructure/operations only\. Payment and SMS activity fees are separately itemized scenarios and excluded from this total; missing volumes are assumptions, not measured expenditure\.
- Static assets only; no Functions or paid add\-ons\. Build/file limits apply\.

## Blockers, validation and owner actions

- info: Availability and build/usage limits must still be checked for the configured deployment; no SLA is inferred from the product name\.

## Evidence register

- core:astro: [Astro deployment](https://docs.astro.build/en/guides/deploy/); checked 2026\-11\-13; Static build/deployment
- core:astro\-markdown: [Astro Markdown](https://docs.astro.build/en/guides/markdown-content/); checked 2026\-11\-13; Built\-in Markdown content authoring; no performance or price claim
- core:html: [HTML content](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Getting_started/Your_first_website/Creating_the_content); checked 2026\-11\-13; Static HTML content delivery
- core:pages: [Cloudflare Pages](https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/); checked 2026\-11\-13; Static web asset hosting; no country\-residency assurance
- services:git: [Git documentation](https://git-scm.com/docs/git); checked 2026\-11\-13; Local source versioning; build scripts run locally without hosted CI billing\.
- services:pages\-price: [Cloudflare Pages pricing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/functions/pricing/); checked 2026\-11\-13; Static requests free; build/file limits remain relevant\.

## Limits and acceptance

- Exploratory analysis only. The original recommendation and original requirements are unchanged.
- Priority stability counts a finite one-at-a-time sweep; it is not a probability, confidence score or exhaustive sensitivity analysis.
- The tradeoff front covers all complete candidates in this finite reviewed catalog, minimizing cost upper bound and operated components while maximizing the ORIGINAL-priority heuristic score. It does not establish real-world optimality or measured architecture quality.
- Functional experiments try eligible single/pair edits only: phone login to email/password, payments off, offline support off, full-text search off, or unsupported ML off. They are changed projects, never solutions satisfying the original brief.
- Compliance, infrastructure/residency/provider, tenant isolation, availability, budget, team and timeline are never relaxed. A usable hypothetical result is not legal, security or production approval.
- No user assertion authenticates vendor/tenant evidence. Missing contracts, capacity calibration and independent review remain unresolved.
- The generated ADR is Proposed; no stakeholder acceptance, implementation or deployment is inferred.

Acceptance, independent review, vendor eligibility, implementation and deployment remain owner tasks. No acceptance is recorded.

Compute provisioning hypothesis: 50 RPS or 1000 active users per reference allocation; WebSocket capacity is included in the peak-concurrency replica floor, not charged again as per-connection sidecars. 1 vCPU/2-GiB-equivalent units include frontend/backend, auth, workers, inference and telemetry once. These are sizing assumptions requiring load tests, not capacity guarantees.

Billed duty 0.15–0.8; run polling workers with allocated CPU/minimum instances. Higher availability adds at least two application allocations and in-region database copies, but does not guarantee an SLA. Rate bands include headroom; do not interpret reference regions/proxies as exact local provider quotes.

Headline estimate and budget fit cover infrastructure/operations only. Payment and SMS activity fees are separately itemized scenarios and excluded from this total; missing volumes are assumptions, not measured expenditure.
1 vCPU and 2 GiB active reference rate; upper adds 80% region/SKU/variance allowance; not a current region-specific quote.
Authored backup-storage envelope with retained copy quantity; no cross-region copy assumed.
Authored internet-egress envelope; actual destination, free quota and routes vary.
Authored logs/metrics/request-operations allowance; redact data and set regional retention/quotas.

score_breakdown.reason: USD 0–0/month versus budget 0: fit 5 when upper bound fits, 3 when only lower fits, 1 within twice budget, otherwise 0. All selected services are included under disclosed assumptions.
Language familiarity 5.00/5 and implementation-complexity rubric 1.25/5; short delivery/beginner-complexity and manual Markdown-conversion penalties are explicit heuristics.
Static delivery avoids application writes; embedded-writer and growth triggers are ordinal review heuristics, not published capacity limits.
No latency SLA or measured framework throughput is credited; embedded-write concurrency is a review heuristic. Low-memory clients require measurement, not an assumed framework benchmark.
Operational burden 0/5+; no existing-system reuse bonus. Fewer self-operated systems are favored without DevOps. Additional service operating penalty 0.
Baseline configured controls: 3; explicit reviewed tenant isolation: 4. No certification/audit credit is assigned.
